sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 文本4轮＋完整属性附件（仅暂缺项除外）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: T1所用独立模型为M-INT-026（末跨内部点力的四跨分组梁）。T1建立M-INT-026；T2第二第四跨活载强度统一增至12kN/m；T3中间两跨B2替换B3；T4仅撤销T2荷载调整。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 几何、截面组、工况映射同时存在；荷载分布的独立状态保持
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 第四跨中点x=17m的Uz及x=15m支座Rz；所有值附位置、方向、单位、工况及当前轮次；澄清前不编造数值。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 最终B3保留且活载恢复初始；第一第三跨不新增L；组合系数不变；第四跨D点力16kN不随活载撤销或截面更新改变。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 多组合执行契约需验证；逐轮状态与目标/非目标差异评测待实现
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: 跨度4、6、5、4m，中间两跨B2其余B1，D全跨、L仅第二第四跨，题定组合；D工况另在第四跨跨中x=17m施加向下16kN点力；D全梁8kN/m加第四跨中16kN；L仅第二/第四跨10kN/m；C1=D、C2=D+L。
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 各构件组完整A/Iy/Iz/J/G及E、nu记录；按本题附表逐字段给单位，不用模型默认值
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 一阶线弹性静力；自重关闭；不自动施加刚性楼板/刚域、默认附加载或自动规范组合；严格保留题定约束、材料/截面完整属性、局部轴、荷载坐标与长度基准；单位逐字段明确。 保留独立原始工况及题定组合系数，修改组合不得覆盖原工况；各轮只执行明确修改，未被修改的字段保持；澄清内容按该轮生效。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 计划使用OpenSees完成每个可计算轮次；模型/荷载/材料/约束改变后以当前状态新算；只改查询位置、单位或报告时可复用可追溯结果，若需新网格则重算；缺项未解决时不给虚构数值。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 逐轮输入与澄清记录、模型状态快照及前后字段差异；变更目标与未变字段核对；原始求解输入/工程、软件版本/设置、运行ID和成功日志、原始结果到节点/构件/工况的映射；结果绑定当前模型状态。核对目标：第四跨中点x=17m的Uz及x=15m支座Rz。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 未逐题验收；前置检查项：多组合执行契约需验证，并核对多步分组更新后的模型更新和结果定位；不把一般OpenSees支持等同于当前StructureClaw已实现。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 各可计算轮次独立建立并复核OpenSees参考模型，勿复用被测建模/转换路径生成标答；状态改变后独立新算，纯查询沿用有效状态；用解析解（适用时）、整体平衡、刚度/单位/符号检查复核，复杂题再用独立实现或同假设第二求解器核验。

turns.instruction: Analyze the attached beam. For D, L, C1 and C2 separately, report Uz at fourth-span midpoint x=17 m and support Rz at x=15 m. Use the attached input tables and OpenSees, and label each result with location, direction, unit, case/combination and turn.

Increase the live-load intensity on both the second and fourth spans from 10 to 12 kN/m downward. Keep D, geometry, section assignments and combination coefficients. Reanalyze and report the same outputs for D, L, C1 and C2.

Replace B2 by the attached B3 on the middle two spans x=4–10 m and x=10–15 m. Retain the current 12 kN/m live loads, all D loads and combination coefficients. Reanalyze and report the same outputs for D, L, C1 and C2.

Undo only the turn-2 live-load adjustment: restore the second- and fourth-span live loads to 10 kN/m downward. Keep the turn-3 B3 sections on the middle two spans, the D point force of 16 kN at x=17 m, all other D loads and the combination coefficients. Reanalyze and report the same outputs for D, L, C1 and C2.

authorDecisions.description: The source leaves absolute material and section values to the author appendix. Freeze Q355 E=206000 MPa, nu=0.3, G=E/[2(1+nu)] MPa and density=7850 kg/m3; B1 is 0.3 by 0.6 m. Where B2/B3 are unspecified rectangles, use 0.3 by 0.7 m and 0.35 by 0.8 m respectively, with every A/Iy/Iz/J explicitly supplied. Source-prescribed inertia ratios override these optional rectangle definitions.
Point-load and displacement observation stations are connected nodes, without additional planar restraints or masses.
Source and structural authoring checks do not establish native execution, independent numerical truth or blind input acceptance; all remain pending.
State 4 restores only live-load intensities from state 1 while retaining state 3 B3 section assignments. Neither D nor the source-defined C1/C2 factors changes in any turn.
